# Parse the old_songs.txt content to extract song titles and artists.
import re

file_content = file_result['content']
target_songs = set()
for line in file_content.strip().split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if not line.startswith('- '):
        continue
    entry = line[2:].strip()
    # Split on " by " to separate title and artists
    if ' by ' in entry:
        title_part, artists_part = entry.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_part.split(',')]
        # Normalize key: title lower, sorted artist names lower
        key = (title.lower(), tuple(sorted(a.lower() for a in artists)))
        target_songs.add(key)
print(f"Target songs count: {len(target_songs)}")
for k in target_songs:
    print(k)
